items.title: Hindalco Q2 FY27 profit up 59% to Rs 7,533 cr on aluminium upstream strength
items.text: Hindalco reported consolidated Q2 FY27 net profit of Rs 7,533 crore (+59% YoY), revenue of Rs 91,708 crore (+39%) and EBITDA of Rs 13,757 crore (+42%), with the aluminium upstream EBITDA margin at 52%. Quarterly capex was Rs 20,719 crore (+83%), much of it on the US Bay Minette project, and net debt/EBITDA rose to 1.80x from 1.23x. Strong upstream cash flow supports funding for Indian smelter growth such as the Aditya expansion, which underpins future AlF3 demand; the article did not mention AlF3.

items.title: Paradeep Phosphates Q2 FY27 profit falls 65% to Rs 121 cr on inventory write-down
items.text: Paradeep's board approved Q2 FY27 results on 29 Oct: revenue from operations rose 7.2% to Rs 7,364.06 crore, but consolidated net profit fell to Rs 121.01 crore from Rs 341.94 crore a year earlier (69.2% below Q1's Rs 392.55 crore), after a Rs 59.98 crore inventory write-down. Subsidy income is booked on Kharif norms as the Rabi subsidy notification is awaited. The coverage opened did not mention the Rs 250 cr AlF3 plant, so there is no new AlF3 progress; the weaker earnings matter only for the company's capacity to fund it.
